scenarios.name: Align the document tabs with the viewport instead of the browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked at the left
the user inspects the bottom workspace rows
the browser extends to the status area above the bottom row
the document tab strip begins at the viewport's left edge
the document tab strip ends at the viewport's right edge
no document tabs appear below the model browser
the status area spans the full application width
